title: Magnetized Ingots
description: A lightweight data pack that adds two powerful magnetic ingots to your world, allowing you to automatically collect nearby items.
body:
![Magnetized Ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7246af9c8fac275c9c4414246966e63f47cfe96f.jpeg)

Magnetized Ingots is a lightweight data pack that adds two powerful magnetic ingots to your world, allowing you to automatically collect nearby items in a natural and immersive way.

Craft an Iron Magnet or upgrade to a Netherite Magnet for increased range and efficiency. Instead of instantly teleporting items, magnets pull items toward the player, creating a smooth and realistic magnetic effect.

## ⚙️ Features

- Two Magnet Types
  - Iron Magnet → 6 or 12 block radius
  - Netherite Magnet → 16 or 20 block radius
- Fully Configurable (via /trigger magnet.options)
- Enable/disable magnet for:
  - Main Hand
  - Off Hand
  - Hotbar
  - Inventory
- Adjust magnet radius
- Reset all settings to default
- Toggle load message
- Easy Reset
-   Restore default settings anytime



## 🔧 Crafting

- Both magnets are crafted using:
- Redstone Blocks (energy source)
- Iron Ingot (Iron Magnet)
- Netherite Ingot (Netherite Magnet)
- (See images for full recipes.)
